tools.description: Read current Tag values via system.tag.readBlocking. Bad/Uncertain quality remains domain data, not Tool failure. Tag property/document sub-paths are rejected. Preserves request order and duplicate paths. D28 ignition-null-v1 encodes logical null as {"$ignition":"null"}; documents containing $ignition are escaped as {"$ignition":"object","entries":[[key,encodedValue],...]}. Arrays and objects recurse; see tag_read_output Resource schema. Example: {"tagPaths":["[System]Gateway/SystemName"]}.
tools.name: tag_read
tools.title: tag_read

tools.description: Browse a bounded Tag hierarchy using system.tag.browse. UDT definition namespace _types_ is excluded. Results are never silently truncated: a partial bounded browse returns limit_exceeded.

path.description: Absolute provider-qualified Tag path such as [default]Folder or [System]Gateway.

recursive.description: Whether to recursively browse descendants. Default false.
